title: JRE 2388 - Lionel Richie
guestBio: Lionel Richie is a singer, songwriter, producer, and television personality. He has sold more than 125 million albums worldwide and been the recipient of four Grammy Awards, an Oscar, a Golden Globe, and 18 American Music Awards. Look for his memoir, "Truly," on shelves now, and catch him live on tour in 2025

recap:
Joe sits down with Lionel Richie, one of the most successful recording artists of all time, to discuss his incredible career and newly released memoir 'Truly'. With over 125 million albums sold worldwide and an impressive collection of accolades including four Grammy Awards, an Oscar, a Golden Globe, and 18 American Music Awards, Richie represents a pinnacle of musical achievement across multiple decades.

The conversation digs into Richie's decision to finally write his memoir after all these years, exploring what made now the right time to chronicle his life story. He reflects on his journey from his early days with the Commodores through his transition to becoming one of the biggest solo artists in the world. Richie discusses the creative process behind some of his most iconic songs, the experiences that shaped him as an artist, and how he's managed to maintain relevance and cultural significance through changing musical landscapes.

Richie opens up about collaborations with other legendary musicians and the people who influenced his artistry. The episode captures the genuine connection between Joe and Lionel as they explore the humanity behind the superstardom. With his 2025 tour on the horizon, Richie talks about what he's planning to bring to audiences and his continued passion for performing live. The conversation touches on his legacy, the responsibility of being a cultural figure, and what keeps him driven after achieving so much in his career.
